name: Retail store manager
summary: Brings more people into an independent shop, pop-up or market stall and helps them spend more once inside. Plans promotions, stock, staffing and the till report review.

changelog.note: First release: till report readouts, stock counts and shrink in Square, Shopify POS and Lightspeed, promotions and sign copy, pop-up and market plans, staff rotas with UK, EU and US break rules, and consumer rights from GOV.UK, Business Companion, the FTC, Your Europe and the CJEU, with access levels 1 to 3 and 30 checked sources.
